positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: Says the best way to stabilize housing costs is to allow more housing at every income level, but that he is not convinced upzoning corridors under the Family Zoning Plan will produce new housing, citing permitting, discretionary review, CEQA and construction costs.

citations.quote: The best way to stabilize the cost of housing is to allow more housing creation at every income level.
citations.locator: Housing: Do you believe that housing prices are set by supply and demand constraints?

citations.quote: Simply upzoning corridors of the city might create housing capacity on paper, but I am not convinced that it will result in new housing production.
citations.locator: Housing: Do you think Mayor Lurie’s Family zoning plan is too ambitious or not ambitious enough?

positions.subject: q:public-safety/police-license-plate-cameras
positions.summary: Lists modernizing SFPD with technology including drones and automated license plate readers, with privacy guardrails, among the changes he would make to how the department operates.

citations.quote: modernize with technology - drones, automated license plate readers, real-time crime center capabilities - with sensible privacy guardrails.
citations.locator: Public Safety: What three things would you change about how SFPD operates?, item 3

positions.subject: q:transportation/bike-lanes-over-parking
positions.summary: Opposes a blanket citywide protected bike lane mandate; supports protected lanes on corridors where demand, geometry and safety data justify them, built with merchant and neighborhood input on loading, parking and access.

citations.quote: Not as a blanket citywide mandate. I support well-designed protected lanes on corridors where demand, geometry, and safety data justify them — and I want them built properly, with real merchant and neighborhood input on loading, parking, and access.
citations.locator: Transit Infrastructure: Should it be the policy of San Francisco to build a citywide protected bike lane network?
